sentences: Polynomial circuit upper bounds for NP would assert small nonuniform computations for nondeterministically verifiable problems.
The saved question concerns whether such bounds are unprovable in \(T_{2}^{1}\).
It studies limitations of a formal arithmetic theory rather than directly proving that the circuit upper bounds are false.
A separation between truth and available formal proof would clarify which reasoning principles are needed for major complexity assertions.
